title: An environment's committed settings, infra/env/<env>.json (#295)
description: The public choices for one environment, which infra/main.bicepparam and the environment scripts read. Every setting infra/main.bicepparam reads is listed here, and x-usnm-visibility says where it lives: public, in the committed file; private, in the settings store (an App Configuration store shared by the subscription's environments) under the environment's label, and never in the repository; local, in the environment's local settings file, written by the scripts. A setting left out takes its default in infra/main.bicepparam. Checked by scripts/lib/env_settings.py --check.

AZURE_ENV_NAME.description: Local: in the environment's local settings file. The environment's name, which the scripts set from --env.

AZURE_LOCATION.description: Local: in the environment's local settings file. The region, which scripts/bootstrap.sh sets (see its --move).

USNM_ALERT_EMAILS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. Alert recipients' email addresses.

USNM_API_CERT_ID.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. A managed certificate's resource id, which names the subscription.

USNM_ARCHIVE_ACCOUNT.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The archival account's resource id, which names its subscription.

USNM_EXPERIMENT.description: Local: in the environment's local settings file. dev's current experiment (an issue number), which scripts/stand-up.sh sets and scripts/teardown.sh clears.

USNM_EXPERIMENT_STARTED.description: Local: in the environment's local settings file. When dev's experiment started, which every provision of dev sets.

USNM_GITHUB_REPO_IDS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The repository's owner and repository ids, which the CI identity's federated credentials trust.

USNM_IMAGE_TAG.description: Local: in the environment's local settings file. The image tag dev runs, which scripts/stand-up.sh sets to the commit it builds; elsewhere the default (main).

USNM_OCR_KEYVAULT_ADMINS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. Entra object ids given Key Vault Secrets Officer on the OCR nodes' vault.

USNM_OCR_NODE_GROUP.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The OCR nodes' Entra group's object id.

USNM_OCR_NODE_IPS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The OCR nodes' public IP addresses (the operator's home IP).

USNM_OCR_USERS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. Entra principals given access to Document Intelligence.

USNM_SEARCH_LOG_READERS.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. Entra principals that may read the search log.

USNM_SERIALSET_RUNNER.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The on-prem Serial Set runner's identity's object id (an OCR node's Arc machine identity).

USNM_SITE_CERT_ID.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. A managed certificate's resource id, which names the subscription.

USNM_VNET_ADDRESS_PREFIX.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. The VNet's address space, an RFC 1918 block (no private addresses in the repository, #399).

USNM_WWW_CERT_ID.description: Private: in the settings store, under the environment's label. A managed certificate's resource id, which names the subscription.
